connectPhp.versionQualification: core surface reconstructed from public v1_1 generated stubs; examples target v1_4 namespace style

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Instantiate Answer and persist with save().
bindingDifferences.rest: POST /answers. Current REST v1.4 requires answerType, language and summary.
GET /answers/{id} or GET /answers with REST query parameters.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Modify the Answer object and call save().
ROQL can query Answer and related CCOM data in-process.
bindingDifferences.rest: Collection GET exposes fields, limit, offset, orderBy and filtering semantics.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Legacy Connect PHP stubs expose integer timestamps.
bindingDifferences.rest: REST v1.4 exposes date/time values as strings.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: RNObject supports SuppressRules, SuppressExternalEvents and SuppressAll.
bindingDifferences.rest: REST does not expose those PHP constants and uses request-level REST semantics instead.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Legacy RNCPHP uses Links containing AnswerLink entries.
bindingDifferences.rest: Current REST exposes relatedAnswers with learnedStrength, manualStrength and similarityStrength metadata.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: The older Answer object surface does not expose AnswerVersion as a separate property/resource.
bindingDifferences.rest: Current REST exposes answerVersion and a separate /answerVersions resource.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Legacy RNCPHP exposes Comments and CommonComments strings.
bindingDifferences.rest: Those fields are not present in the current REST v1.4 Answer schema inspected for this repository.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Uses FileAttachmentAnswerArray and FileAttachmentSharedArray objects with setFile()/makeFile() patterns.
bindingDifferences.rest: Uses JSON/subresource representations, including base64/form-data fields and attachment-specific flags.

propertyComparisons.notes: PHP AccessLevelArray vs REST named-ID list representation.
PHP Answer object vs REST resource reference.
PHP ServiceCategoryArray vs REST serviceCategories references.
REST binding uses unusual casing for this schema property.

notes: REST-present/unverified entries must not be treated as proven REST-only until the current Connect PHP v1_4 Answer reference is independently verified.
The separate REST answerVersions resource is intentionally tracked as a distinct object and should be documented independently.
Custom fields, language IDs, answer types, access levels and statuses remain site-specific/configuration-sensitive.
